lastCompletedStory.title: Add durable test-quality convention to cam knowledge files

nextStoryContext: Added a concise 'Test quality' bullet to the curated invariants block in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (right after the existing 'Quality gates' bullet), capturing: real I/O at wire boundaries, behavioral DI-fakes fine, no tautological mock-call assertions, document why if you must mock, waitForCondition not fixed setTimeout. Appended the matching grep-on-demand detail bullet to the end of scripts/cam/patterns.md, cross-referencing (not duplicating) the existing DI-fake pattern bullet (patterns.md:20), the anti-shadow-mock lesson (patterns.md:150, CAM-91), the FAKES-LIE HAZARD bullets (patterns.md:324/328/368/720), the tmux-introspection fakes-lie postmortem (patterns.md:52), the no-op-sleepFn CPU-spin gotcha (patterns.md:30), and the flushInk/waitForFrame poll-on-content precedent (patterns.md:454). Wording is deliberately consistent with templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md's 'Test-quality rubric: expanding criterion #2' section (US-002/US-003 of this same CAM-62 PRD) so the same convention survives in the implementer's knowledge layer, not just the reviewer prompt. Neither scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md nor scripts/cam/patterns.md is under templates/ or tracked by the file-size-budget gate (only src/scripts/test *.ts/*.tsx files are globbed by check-file-sizes.ts), so no embed-vendor or budget-ceiling raise was needed. Docs-only story, no external library touched, no new tests needed (oracle criteria were file-assert greps only); full bun run check:all spine (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md) ran green.
